cristal-den/caravan-leader.about-caravan: The caravan ? Who are you people ?
cristal-den/caravan-leader.about-caravan-answer: Who we are ? The blood and veins of the cristal wasteland, that's who we are ! We secure trade routes and bring goods from all over, and to wherever.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.about-celestial-device-answer: Never heard of it, sorry. But if it's some kind of pre-war tech, the Steel Rangers might know. We stop by their bunker fairly regularly, hauling supplies back and forth.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.about-expedition: Tell me more about these expeditions.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.about-expedition-answer: Every so often we send a crew down towards the Rangers' bunker to thin out the ferals blocking the road. Doesn't happen as often as the caravan runs, but it pays a lot better. You interested, or just curious ?
cristal-den/caravan-leader.about-expedition-danger: How dangerous is this job, really ?
cristal-den/caravan-leader.about-expedition-danger-answer: Dangerous enough that I don't send anypony out there alone, or green. We lose ponies on these trips. If you're not ready, don't go. If you are, the pay makes it worth the risk.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.about-expedition-ghouls: What can you tell me about the ferals out there ?
cristal-den/caravan-leader.about-expedition-ghouls-answer: Ghouls used to be ponies, a long time ago. Whatever's left in there isn't much more than hunger. They lose their mind over time, and that's when we call them feral. Some sane ghouls sometimes come around these part, but their company is hardly appreciated. Anyway, the ghouls near the capitals are all feral. They travel in packs sometimes, and every so often there's a big one leading them, meaner and tougher than the rest. Aim for the head, don't let them box you in, and you'll be fine. Probably.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.about-expedition-why: Why does this even matter to the caravans ?
cristal-den/caravan-leader.about-expedition-why-answer: The Steel Rangers make the ammo half the wasteland runs on. Dangerous road isn't exactly good for our business. We keep it clear, we keep the business. Simple as that.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.about-joining: How do I join the caravan ?
cristal-den/caravan-leader.about-joining-answer: Nice ! We're always looking for new blood to replace the casualties ! We have an office downtown: find Narbie Fargo and ask him about joining. He runs this operation… well, the backoffice part of this operation, at least. We're the ones sticking our neck out after all, ain't we ?
cristal-den/caravan-leader.ask-about-arm-module: You haven't happened to come across something called an Atmospheric Regulatory Module, have you ?
cristal-den/caravan-leader.ask-about-celestial-device: You haven't happened to come across something called a Celestial Device, have you ?
cristal-den/caravan-leader.ask-about-ghoul-hunt-aftermath: That was weird, what the hell happened during the ghoul hunting expedition ?
cristal-den/caravan-leader.ask-join-caravan-to-steel-rangers: Could I tag along next time you head their way ?
cristal-den/caravan-leader.ask-join-expedition: I hear you need more hooves for the road-clearing job. I'm in.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.caravan-later: Next caravan will take off on Monday. We'll be going to {{nextCaravanDestination}}.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.entry: Hey. You here to join the caravan ?
cristal-den/caravan-leader.expedition-camp: Let's set up camp and patch everyone up before we go on.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.expedition-debrief: That thing back there... I still don't know what in Equestria it was. Not a changeling, not any ghoul I've ever seen. It just showed up out of nowhere and the whole pack lost it.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.expedition-debrief-confirmed: ...Yeah. Yeah, now that you say it, they weren't fighting it, they were fleeing it. Ghouls don't run from anything, not usually. Something's chasing them clean out of the capital ruins and into the open desert, and I don't like not knowing what. Find out where these things come from, and put a stop to it.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.expedition-debrief-generic: I don't know, what do you think that thing was ?
cristal-den/caravan-leader.expedition-debrief-noticed: ...Hold on. Now that I think about it, did you see how they scattered around that thing? They weren't just retreating from us, they looked properly terrified of it. Ghouls don't spook that easy. Something's driving them out of the capital ruins and into the open desert, and I want to know what it is. Find out where these things come from, and put a stop to it.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.expedition-debrief-perception: It looked like the ghouls were running away from it, not attacking it.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.expedition-in-progress: Not now, sugar. Keep your eyes open and watch our backs, we'll talk once we're back home.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.expedition-in-progress-confident: We're all still standing! Let's keep pushing, I don't want to waste daylight out here.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.expedition-in-progress-doubtful: We've taken some losses... I won't lie, I've got a bad feeling about pushing further. What do you want to do?
cristal-den/caravan-leader.expedition-in-progress-grim: Half my crew is down! We need to turn back, now, before we lose anyone else. I'm not risking any more lives out here.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.expedition-ranaway: So you made it back after all. We thought we'd lost you out there, you turned tail in the middle of the fight and left the rest of us to deal with it. Don't expect a single cap out of me.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.expedition-ranawayReward:
Wasn't sure I'd see you again, honestly. You bailed on us partway through, and that's not something I forget easily. Still, you pulled your weight before that, so here's your cut for that part. Nothing for the rest.

She hands you {{pendingReward}} caps.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.expedition-reward:
You're still standing, and so am I, so I'd call that a win. Here's your cut. Come find me again whenever you're ready for another run.

She hands you {{pendingReward}} caps.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.expedition-source-destroyed: Wait, seriously? No more surprises like that popping up down the road? ...Thank Celestia. That's one less thing keeping me up at night. I mean it, thank you.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.expedition-threat-explained: ...Sombra? As in the old Crystal Empire tyrant? Buck me. I always figured that was just a scary story colts tell each other. If that's what's rotting under the capital, I don't even want to know what else is down there. Thanks for telling me, though, at least now I know what we were actually dealing with.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.expedition-threat-resolved-exit: That's all I've got for now.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.expedition-threat-resolved:
You're kidding. You actually found the damn thing and put it down? ...Good. Real good. That's one less thing keeping my caravaneers up at night. Cristal Den owes you one for that.

I still don't know what in Equestria those things actually were, or where they came from in the first place. Guess I'll never really know.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.expedition-wipedout: We got hit hard out there. Most of the crew didn't make it back. I'm not in the mood to talk business right now, and there's nothing to pay you for besides.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.explain-shadow-pony-origin: Those creatures used to be ghouls. Something down in the old lab twisted them, some leftover magic from a dead king. Sombra.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.join-caravan: Great ! We'll take off anytime now. We're going to {{nextCaravanDestination}}. You're interested ?
cristal-den/caravan-leader.join-expedition: Good, we'll be moving out shortly. It's a rougher trip than the caravan runs, and it pays accordingly. You still in ?
cristal-den/caravan-leader.join-expedition-wrong-day: We're not heading out today. Next expedition leaves in {{daysUntil}} days, come find me then.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.ranaway: So you're here after all ? We thought you were dead, but apparently you just ran away in the middle of the heat ! Caravaners died because of your cowardice ! Forget about getting paid !
cristal-den/caravan-leader.ranawayReward:
Wasn't sure I'd see you alive again. You ran away on us, put all our lives in danger. You still did part of the way with us, so I'll pay you for that. But you're not getting any caps for the way back.

She hands you {{pendingReward}} caps.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.reassure-laurie-source-destroyed: And don't worry about any more of them showing up. I found what was creating them, and I destroyed it.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.reward:
Hey ! I'm glad you made it out alive ! Here's your reward ! Come back whenever you're ready for some more action !

She hands you {{pendingReward}} caps.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.steel-rangers-need-caravaneer: You're not one of my caravaneers yet, sugar. Go see Narbie Fargo about that first, then come find me.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.talk-about-thornhoof-caravan: I'm here to bring a caravan to Thornhoof. They need help.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.tell-laurie-ghoul-threat-resolved: Those things that were chasing the ghouls out of the ruins? Taken care of.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.thornhoof-1-plea-for-help: An entire town needs our help. It's worth taking our chances.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.thornhoof-1-silvertide: I met with Silvertide at Thunderhoof. She still owes you a bottle of rhum, doesn't she ?
cristal-den/caravan-leader.thornhoof-2-will-fight: I'll be there. I have a lot of fighting experience. We'll pass through.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.thornhoof-4-approved: Narbi Fargo gave the green light.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.thornhoof-accepted-whatever-1: That's what I like to hear !
cristal-den/caravan-leader.thornhoof-accepted-whatever-2: Thank you, Laurie. It means a lot.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.thornhoof-caravan-go-later: I still have some preparations to make. I'll see you soon.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.thornhoof-caravan/accept-approved:
So it's settled. We got a deal. I'm gonna round up some reckless ponies who like to run after glory… or death… and we'll get on it.

You want to depart now, or do I wait for you ?
cristal-den/caravan-leader.thornhoof-caravan/accept-whatever:
Hmph, Narbi can choke on his forms. I'm the one who decide where I set foot.
And if he's pissed, I'll just leave a big ol' sack of caps and a keg of beer on his desk… that'll shut him up.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.thornhoof-caravan/combat-failed: Yeah, no. You don't look so tough, I don't think I could rely on you to protect a caravan in such dangerous conditions.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.thornhoof-caravan/combat-success:
You seem like someone who could protect a caravan. Okay. I'm more confident than if I were going with complete newbies. But even with you on board, there's still a small detail we need to go over…

We need Narbi's approval to load a caravan. He's at the caravaneers' office, in the town center. Did you already ask him ?
cristal-den/caravan-leader.thornhoof-caravan/entry: Thornhoof ? Well oh well, you've got guts ! Last I heard, their supply lines were still cut off by raiders. I'm not one to chicken out from a fight myself, but you must have a death wish.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.thornhoof-caravan/pleaded:
Sure. Jobs like those, they tend to end up deep down in a graveyard.

I'm not afraid of death… but I don't like burying my comrades for nothing.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.thornhoof-caravan/provoked: I'm not backing down. But I'm not blindly running into danger either. You want me to lead people into a city that's surrounded, you better give me some damn good reasons.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.thornhoof-caravan/silvertide:
Silvertide ?
You know, I didn't think I'd hear that name again so soon. If she sent you, then it must be worth it. And she does still owe me that bottle… that's as good a reason as any to come and claim it in person !

There's still a small detail we need to go over, though… we need Narbi's approval to load a caravan. He's at the caravaneers' office, in the town center. Did you already ask him ?
cristal-den/caravan-leader.thornhoof-caravan/waiting-to-go: Hey ! The caravan for Thornhoof is ready to depart ! Are we going ?
cristal-den/caravan-leader.thornhoof-caravan/who-else:
It's not my job to save the world. Though you're not wrong… if we don't do anything, they'll all die over there.
You've got the guts for this job.But we still have to figure out if you've got the support.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.thunderhoof-1-provoke: Well if you're not one to run from a fight, now's the time to prove it.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.thunderhoof-1-who-else: If not us, who will do it ?
cristal-den/caravan-leader.thunderhoof-go-see-narbi: I understand. I'll go ask at the caravaneers' office.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.thunderhoof-try-skip-fargo: What's that ? Do we need to fill forms to go on an adventure and save lives ? Don't worry about the white collars, I've been promise a huge bounty for this caravan, they'll be so happy with you when you come back with that load of cash !
cristal-den/caravan-leader.too-many-expedition-failures: You're not joining this one. You've botched too many of these already, and I'm not risking the rest of the crew on you. Find something else to do.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.too-many-failures: Well, you can't join. You've failed us too many times. We need escorts we can rely upon. Maybe find yourself a job you're actually suited for.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.way-back: We're ready to make our way back. Give me a heads up whenever you want to go.
cristal-den/caravan-leader.wipedout:
So you made it back ? I can't say as much for the rest of the caravan. It was entirely wiped out.

We lost a lot of money on this trip. I can't give you a reward. No one can even testify that you actually did your job. I'm sorry.
